artworks.title: Saint Lawrence
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Martin Schongauer
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. The figure faces slightly to the right with their head turned towards the viewer. They have short, wavy hair framing their face and a calm expression. The person wears a long, flowing robe with fringed edges reaching the floor. They hold a large palm branch in one hand and a gridiron in the other hand, which is standing upright beside them. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Luke Drawing a Portrait of the Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a seated woman and a kneeling man, within an indoor space resembling a chapel or sacred room. The seated woman is holding a nude child on her lap. She has long hair and serene facial features. The kneeling man has curly hair and is wearing a long robe and a cap, holding a scroll or image with both hands. An angel is hovering above them with wings spread, resting their hands on a pillar. In the background, there are tall, narrow, arched windows with lattice designs and furniture on the right. The room features architectural elements suggesting it is part of a larger building, such as arches and columns, and offers a view of rooftops and a distant structure through the windows.

artworks.title: Saint Martin
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Martin Schongauer
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One figure is standing with a slight lean to the side, his right leg straight and his left leg slightly bent. His head is turned to the right, with downcast eyes and a serene expression. He has long curly hair, a neatly groomed beard and mustache, and wears a long, flowing garment with billowing sleeves and a large robe draped over his shoulders. He holds a cloak in his right hand and a long sword pointing downward in his left hand. The other figure is seated at his feet, crouched on the ground, with an emaciated body and a distressed expression, barely clothed by a tattered piece of cloth around his waist. There is no visible jewelry on the standing figure. The background is plain with a simple, neutral texture.

artworks.title: Saint Michael
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure in armor standing over a grotesque creature. The figure is clad in intricate armor with detailed etching and holding a sword aloft in one hand. The wings extend outward and the character wears an elaborate cloak with fur trim. The expression is solemn and stern. At the figure's feet is a whimsical creature with a human-like face, horns, and a mischievous grin, defeated on the ground. Flower-like forms are scattered on the ground. The drawing features fine linework, resembling a woodcut or print style with attention to texture and depth through hatching and outlining.

artworks.title: Saint Roch
artworks.description: The image shows an angel helping a figure in a robe against a backdrop with architectural elements and a distant tower. The scene has a figure kneeling in prayer with an angel nearby, surrounded by vertical and diagonal lines. To the right, there is a landscape with a tower. In the foreground, two staffs lean against the wall, and there is an inscription at the bottom. The drawing is done in a style emphasizing line and texture with influences from Gothic and Renaissance styles.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.2 x 20.5 cm (6 x 8 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a scene with a castle in the background and multiple figures engaged in action. The castle has several towers on the left side. In the foreground, there are figures in dynamic poses, including one figure kneeling and another throwing stones. The composition is detailed with lines and shading, typical of intricate engraving techniques. The scene conveys movement and tension through the expressive gestures and postures of the figures.

artworks.title: Saint Stephen
artworks.description: The image displays a person standing upright. The individual is facing forward with a neutral expression, looking slightly downwards. They have curly hair and a smooth complexion. The person is wearing a detailed, long robe and holding a book in one hand and a leaf or branch in the other. The background is a plain, textured surface with scattered rocks. An artist's signature, "I. M," is present below the figure.

artworks.title: Saint Elizabeth of Thuringia
artworks.description: The image shows a woman and a man. The woman stands upright, with her head slightly tilted to the side and a serene expression. She wears an elaborate headdress and a long, detailed garment. The man kneels beside her, adjusting his cap. The woman holds a crown in one hand and there is another crown near her feet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a sword with her right hand and grasping her garment with her left hand. She has detailed facial features, long wavy hair, and wears a crown. She is dressed in a flowing dress with intricate designs. The background includes a floor line, a spiked wheel-like object, and a small pedestal.

artworks.title: Saint Mary Magdalene
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in profile, holding an ornate container. The individual has detailed facial features, shoulder-length hair covered by a headdress or veil, and is dressed in flowing robes with intricate patterns. The background is simple with a tiled floor, and the figure is outlined against a plain backdrop. The text "Maria Magdalena" is included at the top.

artworks.title: Saint Ottilia
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene within a gothic interior. The image features an angel and a woman kneeling in prayer, with an infant-like crowned figure emerging from a small architectural structure or box. The interior showcases gothic architectural elements, including ribbed arches and a tiled floor. There is symmetry and space, with a crucifixion scene visible through one of the windows. The lines and shading create depth and texture, making the figures and architectural elements stand out vividly.

artworks.title: Saint Ursula and Her Maidens
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure standing, surrounded by seated figures. The main person is standing upright, directly facing the viewer, and is crowned with an elaborate headdress with long hair. She wears a decorated gown, holds a staff in her right hand. Surrounding her are six seated figures, all wearing long dresses, engaged in various activities. Two angel figures are positioned in a kneeling posture near the upper part, holding draped fabrics that form an arch above the central figure. The background is a textured surface with linear details, contrasting with the detailed figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Christ as the Man of Sorrows
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image; diameter): 4.3 cm (1 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person with closed eyes and long wavy hair. A circular halo is depicted around the head. The individual appears topless, crossing their hands in front of them with interlocked fingers. The background features a textured surface behind the figure, with an inscription above the person's head and engraved symbols and designs on either side.

artworks.title: Eight Apostles in Four Roundels
artworks.dimensions:
images (diameter for each roundel): 3.4 cm (1 5/16 in.)
sheet: 11.1 × 11.7 cm (4 3/8 × 4 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image contains four circular illustrations, each featuring two standing figures shown from head to toe. In the top left circle, the two individuals are side by side, with one holding what appears to be a cross, both dressed in long robes. Their facial features are detailed with distinctive facial hair and curly hair styles. In the top right circle, the two figures also stand closely, one holding a staff and the other with a key, they wear long flowing robes. Their facial features include beards and wavy hair. At the bottom left, the figures have delicate, expressive faces, one holding a cross-shaped staff, dressed similarly in long robes, with one figure wearing a headpiece. Lastly, the bottom right illustration features two individuals holding a spear together, showing similar facial hair and long robes. Around them is a plain background, and beneath the circles is a decorative initial or symbol, set against a light, neutral background.

artworks.title: Seven Children at Play
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple infant-like figures interacting with laboratory and alchemical objects. The etching shows several nude cherub-like figures with curly hair engaging with various objects related to early science exploration and alchemy. The figures are depicted interacting with objects such as cups, a large bowl on a column, pouring liquid, and other vessels and items like books and a bellows. In the background, there are scroll-like elements. The artwork uses strong line techniques to create depth and texture, portraying a dynamic scene of curiosity and interaction between the figures and the objects.

artworks.title: The Foolish Old Man and the Young Girl
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Master of the Housebook
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures positioned close to each other. The figure on the left has curly hair, prominent cheekbones, and a furrowed brow, wearing a flowing garment with a high collar. The person on the right has a serene expression, softly arched eyebrows, and a gentle demeanor, with intricate knotted hair adorned with a leafy or floral crown and wearing a fitted dress. The figure on the left holds a plate with something round on it, while the figure on the right rests their hands under it. The background features an engraved design with scrolls and illegible script or ornamentation.

artworks.title: The Lovers
artworks.artist: Israhel van Meckenem after Wenzel von Olmutz after Master of the Housebook
artworks.description: The image shows two seated individuals on a bench within an archway setting. The first individual is dressed in a long-sleeved top, shorts, and pointed shoes, with long, curly hair under a round cap. The second individual wears a long dress and a head covering, with hair hidden. They are holding a small furry animal. Nearby, there is a potted plant, an ornate basin, and decorative vines forming an archway. In the background, there is a round emblem with insignia.

artworks.title: The Churchgoers
artworks.description: This print depicts two people standing next to each other. The person on the left is facing to the right, towards the other person, with their hands clasped near their waist, holding a long string of beads. They have a slight smile on their face, and the top of their head is partly covered by a hood. They wear a long, flowing garment. The person on the right is facing slightly to the right, but their head is turned over their shoulder towards the left. They are holding a staff in their left hand, and a small cylindrical object in the right. They have a round face with short hair peeking out from under a tall hat, and they wear a long garment with a cloak over their shoulders. Both people wear shoes with pointed toes. A small foxlike animal is seated near the bottom right corner of the print, scratching its ear with one foot. Swirling ribbons are spread around the two people against a dark background.

artworks.title: The Knight and the Lady
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing next to each other. The figure on the left appears to be a man while the figure on the right appears to be a woman. The man is dressed in armor with a long cape and a hat. The woman is wearing a long dress and holds a key and pouch in one hand. The background features swirling ribbon-like elements.

artworks.title: The Dissimilar Couple
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman standing side by side. The man is positioned with his body slightly turned towards the woman, and his head is tilted in her direction. He has distinct facial features, with a serious expression. He wears a cap with a row of buttons, a long tunic belted at the waist, tights, pointed shoes, and holds a sword. The woman stands with her arms crossed, facing the man. Her facial features are soft, and she wears a tall, elaborate headdress with a lattice pattern, a long dress, and voluminous sleeves. The background has a dark, textured backdrop with a swirling ribbon pattern around the figures, and decorative plants with prominent leaves. The artwork is monochromatic with detailed line work.

artworks.title: The Juggler and the Woman
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures, a man and a woman, against a textured background. The woman stands on the left, holding the man's wrist. She wears a cap and a long gown, with a purse and a container at her waist. The man poses with one leg raised and leans back, with long hair and a tunic. He holds ribbons in his hand. Items like a satchel and a belt are near their feet. Intricate ribbons swirl around them, and a jug rests on the ground.

artworks.title: The Angry Wife
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.7 x 11.1 cm (6 9/16 x 4 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a print showing a woman holding a broom-like object and engaging in a struggle with a man. The woman is on the left, holding the object above her head in one hand and with the other holding the wrist of the man, who is partially kneeling on the left. They both have pale skin and light hair. Above them is a fantastical creature with the body of a snake, wings, human arms, and the face of a beast. A small dog stands near the bottom left corner of the print, looking up at them. Next to it on the ground is what looks like a discarded apron. The ground and dark background are both detailed with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: The Organ Player and His Wife
artworks.description: The image displays two individuals, both shown from head to toe. The first person, on the left, is sitting on a bench with a pottery pitcher in their hands, positioned as if pouring. The second person, on the right, is seated at a musical instrument resembling a small organ, playing the keys. Both individuals have distinctive facial features with a slightly elongated profile and are wearing long robes along with hats or head coverings. The person on the left wears a tall, pointed hat, while the person on the right wears a softer, round hat. They are inside a room with intricately designed interior elements, including a patterned floor and detailed woodwork. There is a small dog sitting on the floor between them. In the background, a bed is visible through an open doorway. Various objects, like a book, a jug, and other household items, are placed on shelves behind the individuals.

artworks.title: Circular Ornament with Musicians Playing near a Well
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate circular design with two seated figures and ornate floral motifs. There are two figures seated among elaborate architectural structures that resemble old temples or towers with pointed roofs. These figures are surrounded by a complex arrangement of vines and floral patterns that encompass the entire circle. The design is detailed with swirling lines that give a sense of motion and intricacy to the composition. The use of shading and line work adds depth and texture to both the figures and the surrounding motifs, creating a seamless integration between the central figures and the border decorations. The artwork shows exceptional craftsmanship in the detailed portrayal of each element within the circular frame.
